4. Craft 4 redstone from 4 redstone ore.

8. Craft 18 redstone dust from 18 redstone ore.
9. Mine 18 redstone blocks from 18 redstone ore.
10. Craft 4 cobblestone from 4 stone.
11. Craft 6 cobblestone from 6 cobblestone.
12. Craft 2 redstone from 4 redstone dust.
13. Craft 6 cobblestone from 6 cobblestone.
14. Craft 1 observer using 1 quartz, 2 redstone, and 6 cobblestone.
